prior_findings.source: History Empty/Current now models temporal image validity; accumulating with !current triggers invalidate_view before frames/weight. Single-frame resolved-only→multi target resets to0 and first blend weight1, publishes Current only when accumulation recorded. Existing current history can extend target without unnecessary reset.

DrawPlan logical count clamps only to native u32 representability before handover; each actual draw is then independently clamped to resident population in render. At amount1 incoming endpoint reaches its own capacity. handed upper-bounded by integer count after float rounding, so subtraction cannot underflow near large u32 counts.

findings.title: Enforce the logical prefix in Buffer::write
findings.scenario: An ordinary parent with logical16 and native allocation16 admits prefix4. Calling prefix.write with eight bytes goes directly to BufferUpload::write_to(nativeBuffer,START), so native validation sees capacity16 and accepts bytes0..8, mutating bytes4..8 outside the admitted logical4 view. The same request via write_at(START,upload) correctly returns a bounds error. Zero prefixes likewise allow nonempty writes through this entrypoint.
findings.source_proof: prefix.rs36-48 checks requested<=logical and physical then returns same Arc with size=requested; mod.rs53-55 never reads self.size. upload.rs52-59 hands only native handle/offset/data to queue. mod.rs69-78 write_at enforces end<=self.size. No runtime witness or stronger arbitrary alias guarantee required.
findings.classification: Affected unchanged consumer gap exposed by the new canonical admitted prefix path, not a defect in prefix range predicate and not a pending780 caller adaptation. Root has separately inventoried the complete write/write_at extension; this report remains pinned to d9 where it is not repaired.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Route zero-offset write through the existing checked logical write_at operation, retaining actual native upload validation/cause, exact device/queue preconditions and valid zero-length native behavior. No new duplicate bounds owner or compatibility API.
findings.acceptance: No queue upload occurs for bytes beyond the current logical extent; both write entrypoints agree at START while valid aligned in-range uploads preserve bytes and native errors. Original tests only; this review executes none.

contracts_revalidated: Fresh complete current renderer and policy/count/quality/preset/frame-state/uniform/draw/deformation/readback source review, not merely checking the three prior finding locations. Full current math, all three shaders, error carrier and material sources read. Dataset Sample reordering changes no method/body/serialized field order. Unchanged manifests/shared leaves/callback helper and partial producers separately identified by exact source hashes.

Canonical Buffer::prefix is pure admission: native size getter returns cached immutable descriptor extent; compare requested against parent logical size and physical extent, including forged parent logical metadata. Reject both overruns with named typed requested/logical/physical byte fields, allow zero/unaligned logical bytes, clone same Arc, original untouched, no allocation/copy/map/submit/wait. Nested prefix cannot regrow a reduced logical parent. No global sealing of public Buffer fields or proof external aliases obey context/mapping rules claimed.

Buffer read checks physical extent, then MappingExtent checked ceil-to-COPY_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT before host Readback admission. Logical3/native4 maps4 and returns3 u8 bytes; logical4/native6 maps4; logical0 returnsempty after host ZST/partial-element check and no native request. A prefix whose aligned map needs unavailable padding still returns a typed read error even when prefix admission itself succeeds. Binding requires nonzero logical extent and bounds actual allocation independently; native binding alignment/capability remains provider admission.

MappingRequest arms cleanup before immediate validation observation; failed map, canceled await, poll/channel/native error drops request and unmaps under native cleanup-only scope without replacing first failure. Mappedview drops before release/unmap; host vector allocated in Readback::new before mappedview. Native progress Wait remains explicit, browser await callback yields eventloop. No SDK scope crosses await. Readback destination uses AnyBitPattern, checked host count, whole elements, allocate-before-copy and set_len only after exact copy. These contracts are unchanged at this pin.

Ranged KernelBatch copy separately bounds both logical operands with checked ends; native scope/alignment/usage/physical/device/samebuffer checks remain provider/context and deferred finish policy. No prefix consumer now silently treats zero as a nonempty binding. Buffer::write remains the one newly reported contrary logical consumer.

Renderer admission checks actual Globals including moving head matrix before replacing pose in still-view key; finite effective pixels/minwidth/strand widths/blend amounts before scene publication/framequeue. Converged recomputes selected representation/blend and effective shading/enabled shadow resolution from cached size. Nonfinite rejected state returns typed RenderInputError cause rather than NaN equality loop. No stronger arbitrary finite shader-output or numerical-physics validity claim.

History now has semantic Empty and Current(slot), no redundant generation. Scene replacements reset last/frames/history. Resolved-only static frames leave Empty; first later accumulating frame resets framecount, uses weight1, writes alternate slot, records Current and count1. Current mean extended to larger target preserves samples; moving keeps max(weight,0.35) and per-level Pending obligations. Sample target0 still means1. Saturating u32 count and u64 denominator avoid arithmetic wrap.

DrawPlan shared logical prefix is split before per-level resident clamp, native population saturates to u32::MAX before narrowing, rounded handed upper-clamped to integer population. Therefore ranges never invert and cards→strands subtraction cannot underflow. Amount generated by finite policy selection lies[0,1]; external arbitrary Selection is not a public constructor of private DrawPlan. Card outgoing/incoming threshold behavior preserves exact supplied endpoint-one cuts. Native layout/population admission remains780 required integration.

Full renderer raw-native constructor/shader/layout/group/upload/deformation/head/cover/resize/render/readback ports keep agreed device-handled error policy and device+pairedqueue/resource preconditions. No observed native pass/transactional source publication or browser-safe synchronous headless constructor inferred. Private staging cancellation/drop proof exactSDK identity unchanged, no shared alias guard invented. Readback checked format/row/image allocation/BGRA reorder and typed map/poll/channel causes remain.
